::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Easter day [5 April 1885]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection
:::

My dear [Mary](people/person_1626.qmd) 

[Gertrude](people/person_1462.qmd) has brightened up this week but she had an embarras de richesses on Wednesday for[Jane Harper](people/person_2360.qmd), two children, [Bella Heathcote](people/person_1690.qmd) [Mrs Buston](people/person_236.qmd) and [Emily Dampier](people/person_404.qmd) all came. She could not see the last two but they are coming on Wednesday afternoon to see her.

We had 104 communicants today - 50 early and 54 late. [Frances](people/person_1604.qmd) was neuralgic and could not come out so [Maurice](people/person_1630.qmd) was alone.  [George](people/person_1610.qmd) has grown very tall. Poor [Caroline Martin](people/person_967.qmd) died the night before good Friday.

I never had such a scarcity of primroses at Easter!

Your affectionate 
C.M. Yonge
